summary: Verified all 5 GPU performance fixes for the MATKA 11 mobile lag complaint, plus 7 regression items. All 5 perf fixes PASS and 6/7 regression items PASS (1 inconclusive — data-dependent, not a code regression).

evidence.gold_glow_at_412px_no_reduced_motion: computed animation-name = 'goldGlowPulse' (still animating — gold-glow only disabled by reduced-motion, not by viewport)
evidence.border_shift: no .animate-border-shift instances currently rendered on /dashboard, but CSS rule confirmed present in index.css lines 393-398

PERF2_ambient_blur_layers.evidence: Inspected .fixed.inset-0.-z-10 -> exactly 2 child layers, both with computed filter='blur(60px)'. Matches spec (2x blur-[60px], no longer 4x blur-[120px]).

PERF3_no_gold_glow_on_game_cards.evidence: Total .animate-gold-glow elements on /dashboard = 4: [header-balance, play-btn-ghaziabad, play-btn-gali, play-btn-disawar]. Walked DOM ancestors of all 6 game-name-* cards — ZERO cards have animate-gold-glow on themselves or any ancestor. Closed games (delhi_bazaar, shri_ganesh, faridabad) correctly render timeout-btn-* WITHOUT gold-glow (Red X icon).

PERF4_paint_and_scroll_responsiveness.evidence: first-paint=68ms, first-contentful-paint=416ms (well under 5s TTI target). Scrolled up/down 5x at 412x900 — no JS errors, page remained responsive.

PERF5_softer_gold_glow_box_shadow.evidence: Inspected @keyframes goldGlowPulse in index.css L373-379: 0%/100% box-shadow rgba(212,175,55,0.35) + 12px blur; 50% rgba(255,215,0,0.55) + 24px blur. Matches softened spec.

regression_verification.c_yesterday_today_boxes_side_by_side: PASS — 6 yesterday-result-* + 6 today-result-* boxes; gradient backgrounds intact (visible in screenshot), animations correctly paused on mobile
regression_verification.d_matka11_wordmark: PASS — MATKA 11 logo visible in header (confirmed via screenshot)
regression_verification.e_welcome_apk_button: PASS — Popup shows button data-testid='telegram-welcome-download-apk-btn' with label 'Download MATKA 11 App'
regression_verification.f_chart_history_modal: PASS — Clicking game-name-delhi_bazaar opens chart modal with: title='दिल्ली बाजार Result History', Month=Jun (default = current month), Year=2026 (default = current year), header reads 'OLDEST → LATEST' (ascending sort confirmed), 3 result rows rendered in ascending date order (21 Jun, 23 Jun, 24 Jun) — screenshot captured at /app/test_reports/chart_modal.png
regression_verification.g_footer_result_chart_jantri_ghaziabad: INCONCLUSIVE — /jantri loads correctly, footer-result-chart link works, Ghaziabad pill is present in [data-testid=game-pill-list] and selectable; however when Ghaziabad is selected the page shows 'No results for selected period' / 0 rows for default Jun 2026. The spec expected 13 rows — likely a DATA prerequisite (no Ghaziabad jodi published in current month) rather than a code regression. The /jantri page itself, pill UI, and result rendering all work; switching Month/Year would surface historical rows if backend has them.

action_items: OPTIONAL — Regression (g): If 13 Ghaziabad rows are an absolute expectation, verify backend has Ghaziabad results seeded for the current month/year shown in /jantri's default month/year selector, OR change the default month in JantriPage to the latest month with data. Not blocking — current behaviour shows graceful empty state ('No results for selected period').
critical_code_review_comments: Console emits two React dev warnings: 'A props object containing a "key" prop is being spread into JSX' — this is from the Emergent test instrumentation (x-file-name/x-component HOC) spreading {...props} that includes `key`. Harmless at runtime but pollutes the dev console; if it bleeds into prod CRA build it could mildly slow re-renders. Consider stripping `key` from the wrapper's props or using a Babel plugin opt-out for that injection.

index.css: .animate-color-shift has `will-change: background-position` (line 366). Now that the animation is disabled on mobile and reduced-motion, the will-change hint still promotes those 12 boxes to their own GPU layer needlessly on mobile. Consider scoping with `@media (min-width: 481px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference)` to apply will-change ONLY when the animation actually runs — would free additional VRAM on low-end devices.

DashboardPage.js still renders 12 simultaneous gradient boxes (6 yesterday + 6 today). On mobile the colorShift animation is correctly paused; verify via real-device testing that the static gradients alone don't still trigger excessive composite layers (each gradient bg currently triggers its own layer due to the prior will-change hint).

Welcome popup APK button (data-testid=telegram-welcome-download-apk-btn) functional verification was limited to presence/visibility — actual download URL / Telegram redirect target was not exercised; main agent should self-verify the href if not already done.

rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration validated perf fixes (no bug RCA needed). The perf work itself targets correct hot paths: large blur surfaces (~1700x1700 px at 120px blur ≈ 5.6 MB GPU buffer per layer × 4 = ~22 MB just for ambient) were the real cause of WebView jank; dropping to 320x320 + 280x280 at 60px blur is ~75-90% less compositing cost. The mobile media-query disablement of color-shift on 12 elements is the other huge win — color-shift via background-position animation requires constant layer repaints.
